purpose: Repair Stage-1 supervision so native or mixed-weather references are not treated as absolute zero-uncertainty observations.

scientific_quantity.adapter_output: spatial observation evidence-loss score whose within-pair increment is supervised
scientific_quantity.identified_training_quantity: U(observed) - U(reference) at matched world pose and camera view

supervision.target: measured paired frozen-feature evidence delta with persistent-direction, persistent-magnitude, and transient-inconsistency components
supervision.loss: balanced SmoothL1(asinh(U_observed-U_reference), asinh(target)) plus measured-severity ranking on predicted pairwise deltas
supervision.inference_calibration: subtract a frozen clean/event-precondition baseline before thresholding; calibration is separate from Stage-1 pairwise training

frozen_inputs.initial_checkpoint_role: initialization only; checkpoint selection uses training/route validation losses and never native held-out validation

bounded_repair.checkpoint_selection: minimum frozen mixture of synthetic route-validation pairwise loss and native-training leave-one-route-out loss

decision.both_gates_pass: Integrate the frozen adapter with event-precondition baseline calibration into the minimum learned-UQ closed-loop trace and controlled-stop governor.
decision.glare_pass_native_fog_fail: Stop before learned closed loop; broaden independent native supervision rather than adding synthetic corruption families.
decision.glare_fail: Stop the repair; pairwise native supervision caused regression on unseen synthetic-family localization.
decision.closed_loop_guard: Do not claim that native weather itself is uncertainty; claim only that the learned signal responds to independently rendered evidence degradation and supports selective risk response.
